featured_reviews.name: vikrant mandiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
A not to miss type fish market in Naigaon.
You get a variety of see food here both in wholesale and retail. This is not a very big place but it here you will find all major seafoods fresh..direct from the fishing boats that sell their stuff right on the spot.

You will get pamplets fish, squids , lobsters, carbs, rawas, surmai, bangda...the list goes on...price wise you really have to bargain..here you will get the raw fish ..either you clean n cut yourself or get it done here only at a nominal fees.

Overall if you are seafood lover, you must visit this place someday.

featured_reviews.name: Nagesh Tambat
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of iconic fish market in Naigaon west (Palghar). The market starts at 8.30 pm in the evening and runs until 12 am in the midnight. Also, the market remains closed on Tuesday and Thursday.

Good place for all fish lovers. This place is ideal for buyers who want to buy fish in bulk. Two or Three families can buy the fish together and later on they can divide it so that you will good quantity at low price.

You need to have strong bargaining skills, because the ladies who sell fish will ask for high price and can agree to give even at less than half price which they have initially quoted. So, strong bargaining skills are must needed to buy fish in this market.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
A good place to  get fresh fishes at good prices.
A good place to buy bulk quantity of fish.
There are Auctions too for crate full of fishes..

Things to Keep in Mind Before you go.

1:- Wear.dull.shabby.clothes ( As you are going to be completely covered with fish smell + Sellers might  try to paste you with a hiked price by looking at your look)

2:-Master your bargaining skills before you go.

3:- Carry Container or ample.amount of bags

4:-  Don't Expect Online Payment (Gpay/Paytm /Phonepay or any ). Carry sufficient cash
5:- Keep Eeew Eeew  Feeling aside and go.

featured_reviews.review_text: There's the usual selection of fish at wholesale prices. featured_reviews.name: PratikG. Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: Naigaon Fish Market is WholeSale fish market, where you will get varieties of fresh fishes just landed from fishing boats on same days in market. Please note that this market is only available at 10 pm to 2 pm, hence if you are planning to visit in day, you will get nothing special from here and u need to plan  your visit for night. I would recommend that you come with 4-5  people's and buy entire fish rack and distribute amongst all of u, due to this u will get fishes at low price with more quantities. You can drive bike or car here but due to huge customers vehicles at same time, you may face traffic or congestion. Another way of travelling is that u can use train hence Naigaon railway station is 10 minutes away by auto.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very big fish market from Vasai region. Many small vendors pick up their lot from here and sell in the smaller markets in the morning. featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Rambade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently stayed at Fisherman Village for a monsoon staycation, and it turned out to be a really refreshing and peaceful experience. The moment we entered the property, the entire place felt calm, scenic, and surrounded by nature. Since we visited during the rainy season, everything looked extra beautiful — lush greenery, cloudy weather, the peaceful lake view, and ducks swimming around made the atmosphere feel straight out of a nature retreat.

One of the best parts of the stay was the ambience. The property has a very relaxing vibe, perfect for taking a break from the city rush. Sitting near the lake with light rain and cool weather felt extremely soothing. The view throughout the property was beautiful, especially during the evenings and early mornings. If you enjoy nature, monsoon is definitely the best time to visit.❤️

The food was also very good. The meals were fresh, tasty, and comforting, which added a lot to the overall experience. The staff was polite and welcoming, and the stay overall felt smooth and comfortable.✨

What we loved most was how peaceful and well-maintained the place felt. Whether it was walking around the property, enjoying the lake view, or simply relaxing with family and friends, the entire experience was memorable.🫶🏼

Overall, it was a wonderful staycation experience with beautiful views, good food, and a calm atmosphere. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and would definitely love to visit again, especially during the monsoon season. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway near nature.👌

featured_reviews.name: Isha shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had such a lovely experience at Fisherman Village Resort! 🌴✨
The entire vibe of the place was peaceful, relaxing, and perfect for a short getaway. The property is beautiful, well-maintained, and the atmosphere genuinely makes you feel refreshed. Food, ambience, and overall hospitality were really good.

A special mention to one of the staff members who was extremely patient, polite, and helpful throughout our stay. They handled everything so calmly and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Staff like that truly make a place memorable.

Thank you for such a nice experience would definitely love to visit again! 💛

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at Fisherman Village Resort recently. The place looks nice and the location is good, but a few things spoiled the trip.
The pool smelled strongly of chlorine and felt over-chlorinated. Also saw broken tiles inside the pool — not safe.
Food was disappointing for the price. Most gravies tasted the same (sweet and very red), and the bar had limited options with high prices.
Room was just okay. AC was leaking, the TV switchboard wasn’t fixed, and we heard a sparking noise from TV switch— that felt unsafe.
Room rate only includes breakfast, so you’ll pay extra for lunch and dinner.

featured_reviews.name: V S
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place for bulk buying and selling, however the timigs have changed from mornig 4 am to night  10 pm for auction however make sureu hv good supplier and know the market rates before u stand in auction also chk the stock cause it comes in sizes and can vary if u r not smart enough bussiness pro and cons for sure ..its worth your time should visit once

featured_reviews.name: Aniket K
featured_reviews.review_text: Very Good prices for the Fish but you need those bargaining skills they will try to sell you stuff of 2000-3000 but if you are good at bargaining you can bring it down to 500-600 (remember always walk away and you will get it at the price you want)

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is Pachubandar wholesale fish market. Everyday auction starts at 10.30pm and ends by 12midnight.
Most of retail sellers buy fish in bulk over here and then sell it in various fish markets across the Vasai and Nallasopara.
If you have large family or have party at home then you can buy fish at 50% of market rates over here.
After segregation of fish, few sellers start selling fish in retail at midnight only but you need to bargain with them. Remember they will sell you all fish at market rate if you buy it after auction ends.

featured_reviews.name: Isy Chef
featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh fish available, directly caught from the fisherman, if you are good in bargain it's a best place to buy a bulk amount of fish at very low cost and and then share it with in your friends and families bring smile on the face
